_comment: Gifts sent to the reward box (game spec 7 ter / 7 quater). Rewards: energy, box_capacity, mana, crystal (whole tokens), items {id: quantity}. Founder tiers (V): each player gets the gift of the smallest tier containing their account number (1-10, 11-1000, 1001-10000, 10001-100000). Mana and crystals are minted at the claim, within the MintManager's daily budgets (raised locally by `make budgets-local`): a claim refused for budget works again the next day.
